reason_for_adoption: The pre-incident remote state of this file cannot be proven, and no trusted pre-incident copy survives on HPC. Rather than leave the metric implementation ambiguous forever, the CURRENT file is adopted PROSPECTIVELY by exact hash: from innov-v2.3 onwards every innovation metric is produced by this exact bytes-level content.
historical_integrity_statement: The pre-incident byte identity of scripts/compute_miflu_indicators.py could not be established.
reference_unavailable_explanation: The surviving pre-incident __pycache__ artefact was compiled from a 24236-byte revision while the current file is 24398 bytes, so it is stale and cannot certify the pre-incident content; the local git HEAD blob is an earlier ~13.4 kB revision; no dated pre-incident copy of the 24398-byte revision exists anywhere on HPC; and no output of this script dated after 2026-09-03 exists to reveal which revision was in use.
declaration: The adopted script is the canonical metric implementation from innov-v2.3 onwards. No claim is made that it is byte-identical to the pre-incident remote working copy.
prohibited_interpretation: It must not be represented as proven identical to the pre-incident remote working copy, and size / mtime / pyc-header / bytecode equality must not be cited as proof of byte identity.
provided_functions: compute_peak_indicators(gt, pred, match_tol=2) -> peak_timing_error_weeks (PTE), mean_peak_magnitude_rel_err_pct (PIE), peak_hit_count, n_true_peaks, n_hit, n_missed
